title: A sprint's start warns of an item check that already passes before the work
goal: A new `backlog.py precheck SP` runs each committed item's checks of a planned sprint once, before any work commit, and names as a warning each check that already exits 0 (it proves nothing yet), unless the item states why (a check that pins behaviour that must stay); kb-sprint plan runs it before the start gate is asked, so start itself stays fast. A planted test: an item whose check passes on the base is warned of, one whose check fails is not. Answers the SP-ytfb4dc5 retrospective (ST-f4ra5s7y's grep check passed vacuously on a pathspec git rejected).
